title: Plate Solve Failure by Sky Region
dataSources: NINA sequences (`nina:sequence`), NINA autofocus runs (`nina:autofocus`), Ekos scheduler and device events (`ekos:scheduler`, `ekos:device`), PHD2 guiding telemetry (`phd2:guide`), plate solves (`platesolve:run`), filter wheel events (`filterwheel:event`), and flat frames (`flatlib:frame`).
app: Astrophotography session telemetry from N.I.N.A., KStars/Ekos, PHD2, plate-solving tools, ASCOM gear, and filter-wheel controllers sent to Splunk HEC via logs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=platesolve:run
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as attempts count(eval(status="solved")) as successful by _time sky_region
| eval success_pct=if(attempts>0,round(100*successful/attempts,1),0)
| sort - _time
description: Tracks success rate for plate solves by sky region.
value: Failure rate by region can expose poor metadata, star-starved fields, or horizon obstructions.
implementation: Capture explicit outcome states for plate solves events in `index=personal` and review both attempts and success percentage over time.
visualization: Time chart of success percentage for plate solves by sky region.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers how often plate solves works the way you expect instead of quietly failing.
